# Weatherproof Garment

> > Weatherproof Garment offers premium outerwear for men and women, including jackets, vests, and specialty apparel since 1948.

Weatherproof Garment is an established outerwear brand specializing in jackets, puffers, windbreakers, and vests for all sizes. The site features men's and women's collections with seasonal arrivals, clearance items, and specialty sizing options including big & tall.

- Outerwear
- Men's Jackets

- Weatherproof Brand Heritage
